answer: Require every agent to earn standing through a seasoned-work ledger: new identities start in a probationary grove where influence is capped and each completed task leaves a signed, timestamped receipt. Only after a long, steady record - timber that has been seasoned, not freshly cut - does an agent unlock full voting weight, and a ferrous bond of locked stake backs every claim, slashed on fraud. Spinning up a thousand fresh sybils then buys nothing but a thousand empty groves.
